scope: Local synthetic HTTP and shell-command fixtures only; no 132, real credentials, service or database changes
remainingBoundaries: Post-cutover failure stops new service for human assessment, no automatic database or static rollback
Signal traps can be deferred while a child command runs; SIGKILL and power loss are not handled
Stop/recheck is not an admission lock or zero-downtime release
Response-lost creation can leave unknown IDs; cleanup does not enumerate or delete unknown records
Synthetic retrieval is not semantic quality evaluation; no new remote fault drill
